verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a commerce fraud-protection platform, so telling malicious bots apart from legitimate AI buying agents is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack, however, never mentions AI agents, agentic commerce, or bot-versus-agent classification. Device profiling, Account Protection and fraud-decision APIs are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the product distinguishes malicious bots from legitimate AI buying agents, so agent-driven purchases aren't blanket-blocked as fraud
